title: Actual finite-Q3 local commutator recurrence audit and unsplit-flow boundary
question: Does the EXP-001151 one-layer local recurrence hold for the exact finite unsplit Q3 Hamiltonian flow on the declared four-context q/p Gibbs seminorm?
method: Build the registered quartic Q3 Hamiltonian on the target edge, square face and 2x3 rectangular graph with oscillator dimension three and beta one.
Evolve the supported character and its adjoint with both real-time signs at six steps of delta=1/18 under the exact unsplit unitary exp(-i t H).
Define L_x from the two-sided Gibbs seminorms of [q_x,A_t] and [p_x,A_t] and test L_x(n+1) <= (1+C delta)L_x(n)+J delta sum_(y~x)L_y(n) with C=J=1.
Rebuild the oscillator, graph, Hamiltonian, Gibbs state and all four contexts in a non-importing independent lane; compile Lean R325 only for the exact scalar recurrence fixtures.
finding: Primary 98/98 and independent 92/92 pass as finite audits, integrated 36/36 passes, and Lean R325 compiles. The candidate outcome is FAIL_ON_GRID_ROUTE_LOCAL for the unsplit flow: at volume 6, site 5, step 0, all four contexts have lhs=6.5371290e-7, rhs=1.4959333e-14 and residual=6.5371289e-7. Volumes 2 and 4 have no positive residual under the same finite tolerance.
decision_reason: The exact unsplit finite Q3 flow has an immediate small tail at a site beyond the initial support, so it cannot be substituted for the registered one-layer split-history recurrence with C=J=1. This is an adversarial applicability boundary, not a no-go theorem: EXP-001151 concerns partial onsite/bond split products, and the split-step recurrence remains to be tested directly.
boundary: Finite unsplit Q3 matrices, beta=1, one character amplitude, three graph volumes, six steps and four W/W* plus/minus-time contexts. No asymptotic lower bound, no failure of the split dynamics, no common-core theorem, no thermodynamic QFT, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.

adversarial_review.check: The failing rows use exp(-i t H), while the registered recurrence is explicitly for partial onsite/bond split histories; the two are not conflated.
Both real-time signs and both adjoint orientations are evaluated separately.
C=J=1, delta=1/18 and graph adjacency are read from the declared fixture; no fitted constant is substituted.
The positive residual is a finite matrix diagnostic and is not promoted to an asymptotic divergence or global no-go.
Oscillator dimension three is explicit; no exact infinite CCR or common-core conclusion is inferred.
No split recurrence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result follows.
R325 proves only rational bookkeeping and the scope firewall, not the matrix residuals or limits.

qft_interface.closed: A reproducible finite boundary showing why exact unsplit flow cannot be used as the one-layer split recurrence premise.
qft_interface.open: The actual split Q3 recurrence, first/double response, uniform Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

next_action: Implement the same four-context audit for one exact onsite-plus-all-bond Trotter step and test whether the registered one-layer recurrence holds there; retain this unsplit-flow boundary as a scope guard.
no_overclaim: This package is a finite unsplit-flow scope boundary. It is not a no-go theorem for split Q3 dynamics or any QFT construction.
